character.name:
A lone detective in a long dark trench coat, viewed directly from above. The coat is dark charcoal grey, slightly worn. A wide-brimmed fedora hat
  visible from the top. Pale skin. No face visible — just the hat brim. Arms close to the body. Holding a small flashlight or notepad in one hand.      Shoes are dark leather oxford shoes.
                                                                                                                                                        Style: Pixel art OR painterly 2D illustration, top-down perspective (bird's eye view), transparent background, single character, neutral idle pose. 

 Animation note (if it supports sheets): Walk cycle, 4 or 8 directions, 4 frames per direction.
